_meta.notes: Comprehensive index for Singapore covering Temasek/Singapura (Sang Nila Utama legend), Srivijaya/Majapahit, Portuguese raid 1613, Johor Sultanate, Stamford Raffles founding 1819, British Straits Settlements, WWII Japanese occupation (Sook Ching massacre), merger with Malaysia 1963, expulsion 1965, Lee Kuan Yew's authoritarian modernization, economic miracle (entrepot to high-tech), PAP dominance, and city-state governance.

religion.note: Secular state; religious harmony legally protected (Maintenance of Religious Harmony Act); Chinese majority Buddhist/Taoist; Malays constitutionally Muslim; Tamil Hindus; tolerance but sensitive to proselytization

ethnic_groups.name: Chinese
ethnic_groups.notes: Dominant; Hokkien, Teochew, Cantonese, Hainanese, Hakka dialect groups; Mandarin official (Speak Mandarin Campaign 1979); Chinese educated (Nanyang University closed) vs English-educated elite; prosperous middle class; PAP support base

ethnic_groups.name: Malay
ethnic_groups.notes: Indigenous; Singapore is in Malay archipelago; constitutionally special position (President must be Malay); Malay-Muslims; lower socioeconomic status; Geylang Serai; Group Representation Constituency (GRC) ensures representation

ethnic_groups.name: Indian
ethnic_groups.notes: Mostly Tamil (75% of Indians); also Malayali, Punjabi Sikhs, Gujarati; Little India; professionals and workers; historically brought by British

ethnic_groups.name: Other (Eurasian, Caucasian, etc.)
ethnic_groups.notes: Eurasian community (Portuguese-Asian mixed, Kristang creole); Western expats; Filipino domestic workers

independence.from: Expelled from Malaysia (was briefly part of Malaysia 1963-1965); British colony 1819-1963

country_profile.notes_unique: Only city-state in Southeast Asia; Lee Kuan Yew ruled 1959-1990 (authoritarian, meritocracy, anti-corruption); caning for vandalism (Michael Fay 1994); chewing gum ban; death penalty for drugs; PAP one-party dominance (since 1959, never lost power); from third world to first in one generation; Marina Bay Sands; Changi Airport (world's best); water self-sufficiency (NEWater); no natural resources (imports everything); ethnic quotas in HDB housing; 'Asian values'; financial hub

trade.notes: World's most trade-dependent economy (255% trade/GDP); largest bunkering port; semiconductor supply chain critical; 27+ FTAs; entrepôt trade hub; petroleum refining top 3 globally.

infrastructure.notes: Changi Airport best globally; Port of Singapore busiest transshipment globally; MRT railway extensive; COE vehicle quota system; Tuas mega-port ($20B); Johor-Singapore RTS link.

governance_indices.notes: PAP dominant party since 1959 (PM Lawrence Wong 2024); meritocratic governance; low corruption; restrictive media/speech laws; death penalty; GRC electoral system; highly efficient bureaucracy.

geography.terrain: Lowland; gently undulating central plateau; 63 islands; extensive land reclamation
geography.notes: City-state at tip of Malay Peninsula; Strait of Malacca global shipping choke point; 63 islands; 25%+ of land area is reclaimed; tropical; garden city concept.

economy_extended.notes: Global financial center; triple AAA rated; Temasek/GIC sovereign wealth ($500B+); semiconductor/biotech manufacturing; world's busiest port; wealth management hub; income inequality high for developed country.

health.notes: World-class healthcare (Bloomberg most efficient); Medisave/Medishield/Medifund system; medical tourism hub; excellent outcomes despite moderate spending; aging population challenge.

food_agriculture.notes: 90% food imported; '30 by 30' goal (30% nutritional needs locally by 2030); vertical farming/aquaculture investments; food security strategic priority; 170+ import sources diversification.

security_stability.notes: One of world's safest countries; mandatory national service (2 years); FPDA member; significant defense spending for size; Internal Security Act (preventive detention); zero tolerance drug policy.

environment_climate.notes: 2030 Green Plan; carbon tax ($25/tonne, rising); limited renewable options (solar rooftop focus); NEWater (recycled water); Semakau landfill; cross-border haze from Indonesia.

demographics_extended.notes: Chinese 74%, Malay 13%, Indian 9%; lowest fertility globally (1.0); aging crisis; immigration-dependent growth; bilingual policy (English + mother tongue); PISA top performer.

comparative_rankings._note: Country position relative to continent and global.
comparative_rankings.notes: City-state; global financial center; world's busiest port; highest HDI in Asia; 'Garden City'.

cultural_heritage.national_dish: no official; contenders: chicken rice, laksa, chilli crab
cultural_heritage.media_landscape: Straits Times (English); Lianhe Zaobao (Chinese); Berita Harian (Malay); CNA (Channel NewsAsia); tightly managed media environment.
cultural_heritage.notes: Multi-ethnic harmony model (Chinese 76%, Malay 15%, Indian 8%); hawker centres; Singlish; Marina Bay Sands; world's most expensive city; efficiency and order.

energy.notes: Natural gas dominant (95% of electricity); major oil refining hub; no domestic energy sources; importing electricity from Laos/Malaysia (ASEAN Power Grid); rooftop solar; hydrogen research.

human_rights_gender.notes: PAP dominant-party system since 1959; strict laws (caning, death penalty for drugs); limited press freedom; POFMA (anti-fake news); efficient governance; Section 377A repealed 2022.

legal_system.sharia_applicability: AMLA (Administration of Muslim Law Act) for Muslim personal law; Syariah Court
legal_system.notes: Supreme Court (Court of Appeal, High Court); renowned for rule of law and contract enforcement; SICC (Singapore International Commercial Court); low corruption; mandatory death penalty for drugs.

tourism.notes: World's most powerful passport; Changi Airport ('World's Best' repeatedly); MICE tourism; Sentosa integrated resorts; food tourism; F1 Singapore Grand Prix night race.

transport.notes: Changi Airport (Terminal 5 under construction); Port of Singapore handles 37M+ TEU; MRT world-class; ERP (Electronic Road Pricing); COE system (car ownership); Johor Bahru–Singapore RTS Link planned.

current_leader.name: Lawrence Wong
current_leader.title: Prime Minister
current_leader.notes: PAP; fourth-generation leader; economist; former Finance Minister; COVID-19 task force; succeeded Lee Hsien Loong

president.name: Tharman Shanmugaratnam
president.title: President
president.notes: First Indian-origin president elected by popular vote (ceremonial role); economist; former DPM; highly respected globally

former_leaders.name: Lee Hsien Loong
former_leaders.notes: Eldest son of Lee Kuan Yew; PAP; mathematician/general; cancer survivor; smart nation; family feud over Lee Kuan Yew's house (with siblings); wife Ho Ching (Temasek Holdings CEO)

former_leaders.name: Goh Chok Tong
former_leaders.notes: PAP; 'kinder, gentler' Singapore; financial crisis 1997; allowed more political openness; transitioned from LKY to LHL

former_leaders.name: Lee Kuan Yew
former_leaders.notes: Founding father; Cambridge-educated; authoritarian modernizer; 'Minister Mentor' until 2011; meritocracy, anti-corruption, multiracial, English-language policy; transformed fishing village to first world; died 2015 (state funeral); wife Kwa Geok Choo (lawyer)
